# Syntaxure Labs

> Syntaxure Labs is a global B2B digital transformation agency specializing in scalable custom software, web architectures, and secure AI integrations. Creators of Context Engine for AI governance. Based in Iloilo City, Philippines. Est. 2025.

## Services

We offer fixed-investment pricing with predictable timelines. Every project starts with a free consultation and scope proposal delivered within 24 hours.

### Custom Websites & Web Applications
High-performance websites and web apps that load instantly, rank well on Google, and convert visitors. Custom design, mobile-first, SEO-optimized.
- **Timeline:** 2-4 weeks
- **Starting at:** PHP 150,000
- **Details:** https://www.syntaxure.dev/services/web-development

### SaaS Platform Development
Multi-tenant SaaS platforms with user accounts, subscription billing, RBAC, and ready-to-launch foundations. Full deployment pipeline included.
- **Timeline:** 4-8 weeks
- **Starting at:** PHP 250,000
- **Details:** https://www.syntaxure.dev/services/saas-platforms

### Cloud Hosting & Infrastructure
Enterprise-grade cloud hosting with 24/7 monitoring, automatic scaling, security updates, and disaster recovery. Fully managed.
- **Timeline:** 1-2 weeks setup + monthly hosting
- **Starting at:** PHP 80,000
- **Details:** https://www.syntaxure.dev/services/cloud-architecture

### AI Integration & Automation
AI-powered search, chatbots, document processing, and workflow automation powered by Context Engine technology. Custom integrations.
- **Timeline:** 2-4 weeks
- **Pricing:** Custom quote (varies per project)
- **Details:** https://www.syntaxure.dev/services/ai-integration

### Managed Hosting & Maintenance (Monthly)
Ongoing hosting management, security updates, performance monitoring, and maintenance retainer.
- **Starting at:** PHP 5,000-15,000/month

## Flagship Product: Context Engine

Context Engine is a proprietary AI Governance layer that enforces strict protocols and actively prevents AI hallucinations in enterprise environments. It ensures AI agents follow established rules, validates outputs against context, and provides audit trails. Available as a SaaS subscription (pricing available on request).

**URL:** https://www.syntaxure.dev/prism
